en.answer: Even in this scenario, because <<12498>> was targeted for an attack, you can activate its effect. In that case, the part of the effect that Special Summons a Level 5 or lower Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand is applied, but because of the effect of <<12349>>, the part of the effect that makes the Special Summoned monster become the attack target and halves the attacking monster's ATK is not applied. The effect of <<12498>> will finish resolving when the Level 5 or lower Spellcaster-Type monster is Special Summoned, and a replay occurs. However, since the effect of <<12349>> only allows your opponent to attack <<12498>>, the newly Special Summoned monster cannot be selected as the attack target, so your opponent must either attack <<12498>> again or cancel the attack.
